product_form.notes: Specimen type designation and dimensions are not stated; no dimensions are inferred from a cited standard.

processing.text: PLA was introduced into a Brabender Plastograph internal mixer at 190 degrees C and 80 rpm, then PCL was added; these conditions were maintained until constant torque. Retain these as reported setup/range context only; exact per-formulation temperature and pressure settings are unresolved, and no universal molding recipe is assigned to the seven states.
